caption: The drawing depicts a single urn-shaped container with a lid, rendered in shades of brown with golden-yellow outlining. The urn has a vertically elongated oval body, which is segmented with fine gold lines that extend from the base to the top. The lid is dome-shaped with ribs matching the segmentation of the urn’s body, and is topped with a small, finial ornament. The urn sits on a round foot which in turn rests on a square plinth base. The entire object is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorations, and the illustration shows a careful attention to the wood grain and the reflective qualities of the urn's material.
title: Knife and Spoon Box
